metadata.name: Verified Research
metadata.description: Bounded external-source research for one specific question and one evidence-linked local answer. Frames the decision or use, gathers and critically reads a proportionate set of primary and authoritative sources, preserves meaningful disagreement, distinguishes sourced facts, quotations, calculations, inference, assumptions, uncertainty and gaps, and produces complete source-register, readings, answer, limitations, validation and independent-review artifacts. Supports autonomous and interactive operation, useful explicitly limited answers when evidence is incomplete, truthful blocked/aborted outcomes, cause-owned answer or evidence repair, and replan when the criterion or method is invalid. Choose Iterative Research for repeated durable improvement, Universal Research for adaptive filesystem-or-memory and authority modes, or Deep Corpus Research for separately authorized corpus-scale exhaustive reading. Completion is local: this workflow does not publish, notify, commit, deploy or mutate production.

nodes.directive: Resolve one specific research question, its intended use, proportionate scope and operating mode from the user's request and existing context. Reuse explicit choices. Ask only for a missing fact that materially changes the research and cannot be discovered. Return actionable when the question can be researched, clarify only in interactive mode when one user answer is essential, or blocked when autonomous ambiguity or a prerequisite prevents honest research. Do not invent scope or evidence.
nodes.completionCondition: The bounded research contract is actionable, one essential clarification is identified, or the prerequisite blocker is explicit

nodes.directive: Ask the one essential clarification already identified by intake. Integrate the user's answer without expanding the requested outcome. Return ready with the complete canonical question, use and scope, or blocked when the prerequisite remains unresolved.
nodes.completionCondition: The bounded question is now actionable or the unresolved prerequisite is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Frame the canonical question {{research_question}} for the observable use {{research_use}} within {{research_scope}}. Write framing.md with subquestions, bounded assumptions, applicability, evidence method and what would make the answer useful, limited or impossible. Do not prescribe fixed source counts, providers or search tactics. Return ready, replan for an invalid criterion/method, or blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: The durable framing supports proportionate evidence work or the earliest non-product cause is classified

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}} from framing.md. Gather and critically read a proportionate source set for {{research_question}}. Prefer primary and authoritative evidence where available, preserve meaningful disagreement, and evaluate authority, recency, independence and applicability. Write source-register.md with resolvable links plus retrieval/publication dates, readings.md with claim-level support and limitations, and alternative-views.md. Distinguish missing evidence from negative evidence. Return the sole canonical evidence_status: ready, limited only when residual evidence supports a useful explicitly limited answer, replan for a broken method or criterion, or blocked rather than fabricate support.
nodes.completionCondition: Canonical evidence artifacts support a complete or useful limited answer, or the sole evidence outcome identifies the earliest invalid prerequisite

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Use framing.md, the complete source register, readings, alternative views and primary evidence to write one bounded answer.md and limitations.md for {{research_question}}. Separate sourced facts and quotations, calculations, synthesis/inference, conflicting evidence, assumptions, uncertainty and known gaps. Every material external claim must resolve to supporting evidence. Preserve the current evidence class {{evidence_status}}. Return ready, replan for an invalid answer criterion/method, or blocked when the evidence cannot honestly support an answer.
nodes.completionCondition: The current evidence is synthesized into a traceable bounded answer and limitations, or the earliest cause is classified

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Perform a fresh producer-completion pass over the question, framing, source register, readings, alternatives, answer and limitations. Close obvious omitted claims, broken source links, stale conclusions and contradictions before gates. For ready, derive answer_summary and limitation_summary from the exact current package bytes while preserving the sole canonical evidence_status {{evidence_status}}; do not create a second answer-class alias. This node is the sole pre-gate writer of these bounded summaries and refreshes them after every package or evidence mutation. Return replan for an invalid contract/evidence method or blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: The complete package and its bounded current summaries are producer-ready under the canonical evidence class, or the earliest non-product cause is classified

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Overwrite package-validation.md with checks whose observations actually distinguish the applicable states: required artifact existence and parsability, bounded schemas, resolvable link syntax and internal source-to-reading references. Do not claim source credibility, semantic completeness or conclusion validity mechanically. Before adding any new validator, name the required and plausible wrong states and the observation that separates them; otherwise replan rather than build proof machinery. Return pass, package_repair for answer/package shape, evidence_repair for concrete source-register/link/reading evidence defects, replan for an invalid criterion/method, or blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: Deterministic observations are durable and routed to the earliest owner without semantic overclaim

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Delegate one genuinely independent whole-answer review and keep the same reviewer context for rereview where supported. The reviewer reads the original question/use/scope, framing, complete source register and readings, alternative views, answer, limitations, deterministic observations, primary evidence and the exact canonical evidence_status {{evidence_status}} that will drive the terminal. It verifies that this class matches the package rather than inferring it from route execution, then overwrites semantic-review.md with all current reproducible blockers. It diagnoses without repair, accepts zero findings, and classifies answer/package, evidence/source, invalid criterion/method or upstream causes. Return pass only at zero blockers; repair only for one local owner; replan for mixed/upstream/criterion or repeated unchanged roots; blocked when genuine independence or another prerequisite is unavailable without claiming review.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete independent semantic review or factual inability record is durable and cause-correct

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read package-validation.md and semantic-review.md as applicable. Reproduce every answer/package-owned blocker, repair the complete confirmed class in answer.md, limitations.md or package structure, and record changed relevant knowledge in repair-account.md. Do not patch source defects in prose. Return changed to refresh package completion and all stale gates, reassess for invalid/mixed/unreproduced/repeated roots, or blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: Confirmed answer/package defects change before every stale gate, or non-local causes do not loop

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read package-validation.md and semantic-review.md as applicable, the source register, readings and primary evidence. Reproduce every evidence/source-owned blocker, change the complete confirmed evidence class, and record changed relevant knowledge in repair-account.md. Return changed to repeat research, synthesis, package completion and all stale gates; reassess for invalid/mixed/unreproduced/repeated roots; or blocked for an irreducible evidence prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: Evidence defects change before every evidence-dependent artifact is recomputed, or non-local causes do not loop

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Reassess the earliest invalid interpretation, evidence method or acceptance criterion against the original user question, use, scope and authority. When corrected-contract review has run, read and reproduce every current blocker from contract-review-findings.md before changing the reviewed contract. Preserve the user's goal and still-valid requirements. Write only the corrected bounded contract and changed knowledge to contract-review.md; do not lower acceptance or invent delivery authority. Return corrected when an independently reviewable changed contract exists, or blocked when no honest contract can proceed.
nodes.completionCondition: The earliest invalid derived contract is corrected without requirement erosion, or the run is truthfully blocked

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Delegate a genuinely independent review of the corrected contract in contract-review.md against the original question, use, scope and authority. The reviewer diagnoses without implementing research and overwrites the separate contract-review-findings.md with every current reproducible blocker, or an explicit zero-finding result. Return pass only when the corrected contract is coherent and evidence can distinguish its acceptance; repair or replan returns those durable findings to reassessment; blocked records unavailable independence or an irreducible prerequisite without claiming review.
nodes.completionCondition: The corrected contract has independent acceptance or a truthful blocking result

nodes.directive: Present the independently accepted bounded answer and limitations from {{workspace_path}} together with the canonical evidence_status {{evidence_status}}, answer_summary and limitation_summary. Ask the user to accept, request one bounded rework owner, or abort. Preference cannot override deterministic or independent review. Rework must identify the earliest stale owner: framing, evidence, answer or contract.
nodes.completionCondition: The user accepts the reviewed package, chooses bounded rework, or aborts

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md from the exact independently accepted complete local package whose canonical evidence_status is ready. Preserve answer_summary, limitation_summary and evidence_status without semantic reinterpretation. Report that no publication, notification, VCS, deployment or production mutation was performed. Return artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md and terminal_status complete. Do not mutate the accepted package here.
nodes.completionCondition: The accepted complete local answer and limitations are truthfully projected without a new semantic mutation

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md with the original question, completed useful work, terminal_reason, unavailable prerequisite and what could unblock research. Do not claim independent acceptance or fabricate an answer. Return artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md and terminal_status blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The blocked run has a truthful durable local report without a success claim

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md with the user's abort decision, completed useful work and current limitations. Do not claim acceptance or external delivery. Return artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md and terminal_status aborted.
nodes.completionCondition: The interactive abort is truthfully recorded without a success claim

nodes.hint: Use only when the current research interpretation, evidence method or acceptance criterion is itself wrong or unprovable. A source gap, validation failure or review finding with a sound contract belongs to its ordinary repair owner.
nodes.directive: Explain the process-level defect and the original goal, scope and authority that must remain preserved. Do not use this jump to bypass a failed check or lower acceptance.
nodes.completionCondition: The legitimate process-revision cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Report the observed materialization failure truthfully. Explain that no canonical workspace or accepted research package was produced, preserve the bounded question/use when available, and state the concrete action that could unblock workspace creation. Do not claim research completion or create substitute artifacts outside the canonical workspace.
nodes.completionCondition: The workspace prerequisite failure and recovery action are explicit without a success claim

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md from the exact independently accepted limited local package whose canonical evidence_status is limited. Preserve answer_summary, limitation_summary and evidence_status without semantic reinterpretation. Make the evidence limits and decision effect prominent. Report that no publication, notification, VCS, deployment or production mutation was performed. Return artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md and terminal_status limited. Do not mutate the accepted package here.
nodes.completionCondition: The accepted limited local answer and limitations are truthfully projected without a new semantic mutation

operating_mode.description: Whether essential user clarification and final acceptance waits are enabled.

research_use.description: The observable decision or use the answer must support.

research_scope.description: Explicit inclusions, exclusions, constraints and authority for this bounded research run.

workspace_path.description: Execution-correlated workspace containing the canonical research package.

workspace_process_id_file.description: Registry-backed execution identifier content for process-id.txt.

evidence_status.description: The sole canonical research evidence outcome: usable complete evidence, useful limited evidence, invalid method requiring replan, or an irreducible blocker.

answer_summary.description: Bounded summary derived from the exact producer-complete answer package before review.

limitation_summary.description: Bounded limitations summary derived from the exact producer-complete package before review.

terminal_reason.description: The current irreducible blocker recorded by the responsibility that observed it.

artifact_path.description: Safe path to the final local research report.

terminal_status.description: Truthful terminal class for the bounded research run.
